data.name: Cristobella
data.gender_notes: Cristobella is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Cristo (Christ) and Bella (beautiful), Cristobella means 'bearer of Christ' or 'Christ-like beauty'. The name Cristobella carries the meaning “Christ bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cristobella usually hope their child will grow to embody christ bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the spiritual qualities of faith and devotion.
data.etymology: Cristobella belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Christ bearer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cristobella total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_greek.name: Χριστομπέλλα
in_greek.long_meaning: τὸ ὄνομα Χριστομπέλλα ἀποτελεῖται ἀπὸ τὴν λέξη Χριστός, ὁ Μεσσίας, καὶ τὴν λέξη βέλλα, ἡ ὁποία σημαίνει ἀγάπη καὶ κάλλος, ἡ σημασία του εἶναι ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἢ τὸ κάλλος τοῦ Χριστοῦ, καὶ χρησιμεύει ὡς Χριστιανικὸ ὄνομα κόρης

in_latin.name: Cristobella
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen Cristobella constat ex vocabulo Christus, Messias, et vocabulo bella, quod significat amorem et pulchritudinem, significatio eius est amor Christi vel pulchritudo Christi, et servit ut nomen Christianum puellae

in_english.name: Cristobella
in_english.long_meaning: the name Cristobella is derived from Christ, the Messiah, and bella, meaning love and beauty, its significance is the love of Christ or the beauty of Christ, and it serves as a Christian name for girls, symbolizing the virtues of love and beauty in Christian tradition

It is a name that celebrates the connection between the individual and their Savior, emphasizing the desire to be like Christ in every aspect. Historically, this name has been used as a reminder of the importance of Christ's teachings and the profound influence they have had on mathematics, art, literature, and architecture, shaping Western civilization and continuing to resonate in contemporary society.
data.spiritual_significance: Cristobella carries a powerful and profound spiritual significance. It is a name that embodies the highest spiritual ideals and encourages those who bear the name to strive for the virtues represented by Christ – love, kindness, compassion, generosity, and selflessness. Therefore, Cristobella is more than just a name; it is a symbol of the close bond between the individual and their faith.
